# OGO Kite Academy

> Kitesurfing lessons in Limassol, Cyprus, plus seasonal kite trips: a luxury catamaran safari in Egypt and a two-week camp in Brazil. Run by a certified instructor with 500+ students taught.

## Pages

- [Home — Kite lessons in Cyprus](/): Personal kitesurfing lessons in Limassol, Cyprus. Beginner to advanced, all Duotone gear included.
- [Egypt Kite Safari](/kite-safari): Week-long kitesurfing safari on a luxury catamaran in Egypt. Coaching, cabins and meals included.
- [Brazil Camp](/brazil): Two-week kitesurfing camp in Brazil with coaching, downwinders and accommodation.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from lessons in Cyprus and trips to Egypt and Brazil.
